name: "Apple Turnover" Double Glazed Donut - 1.5G
description: Apple Turnover Apple Turnover - Fresh out the oven with a modern twist, Apple Turnover balances tart green apple with warm pastry richness and a sneaky edge of gas. Built on the bold profile of Apple Tartz, this hybrid folds crisp orchard fruit into layers of cinnamon spice, buttery dough, and just a hint of sour funk—like biting into a flaky, caramelized crust with a bright, tangy center. Each puff is both sharp and soft, playful and grounded, delivering a high that mirrors the flavor: focused and buoyant with a gentle body melt that never weighs you down. Perfect for crisp mornings or golden afternoons, Apple Turnover is a flakey-laced treat made for those who like a little zing in their zen.
